investigation: Camofox 2.4.8 browser-pin validation in Forgejo CI

ci.build: build-crw on an ubuntu-latest build runner; pushed validation image
ci.isolation: Both stacks use the same candidate CRW, router build, LightPanda pin, and configuration; only the Camofox image differs. ROUTER_SCRAPE_TTL=0s; cloud key empty and cloud credits zero.

reddit.controlError: HTTPError (status 500; response body not retained by the gate)

results.containers: No restarts or OOM kills in either stack

redditBaseline.finding: No valid Reddit baseline exists. Production CRW returns success with a 52-character Camofox truncation placeholder (production-reddit.json). The fixed CRW correctly rejects the same oversized 2.4.6 result, consistent with the control's HTTP 500; the gate did not retain the error body, so that cause is inferred, not proven.
redditBaseline.externalContext: Reddit announced on 2026-09-30 the end of public API access by March 2027 and RSS on 2026-11-13, and restricted anonymous old.reddit access. The Reddit case is expected to become unreliable for reasons outside Fireghost.
redditBaseline.proposedDisposition: Judge the Reddit case on absolute candidate checks (content floor, markers, renderer provenance) and record the missing baseline; all other cases pass relative comparison.

limits: A passing candidate is evidence for review, not authorization to change an image pin or the production deployment.
Reddit content is live and varies between runs.
Rejecting truncated documents prevents false success but does not recover oversized pages; bounded document transfer remains future work.

operations.observedPinDrift: dev/stack.lock.json records crw-camofox@sha256:3898cae0...; production runs fireghost-crw@sha256:9d1428de... via the mutable latest tag.
